channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Malik Beasley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Malik Beasley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Malik Beasley
item.description:
Langdon on if he's talked to Malik Beasley's agent:

“No, I have not. He doesn’t have an agent right now, so that would make it hard.”

Trajan Langdon on Malik Beasley, Jun 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jalen Duren on Tobias Harris, Malik Beasley
item.description:
“We needed that bad, being a young team, we just needed consistent vets, and they don’t only perform on the court but off the court.“Tobias is one guy who’s constantly teaching about all different things — life, financial stuff. Timmy, Malik (Beasley), they’ve very vocal. They’re not guys who are to themselves. They’re part of the group, they’re bringing guys up, they’re constantly competing. They’ve been huge for us.”

Jalen Duren on Tobias Harris, Malik Beasley, Mar 5, 2025. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed
item.description:
“Tobias Harris, whom I've known for a long time. We've got Malik Beasley, Tim Hardaway Jr, and Paul Reed coming in. I feel very good about the offseason with the veterans. I think Trajan Langdon did a good job bringing the right people in, but still keeping flexibility.”

Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed, Oct 9, 2024. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: LeBron James on D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt, Malik Beasley
item.description:
LeBron on the Lakers since the trade deadline (they’re 4-1 since acquiring Russell, Vanderbilt and Beasley):

“I feel like we’re in a good place. We’re gonna try to continue that.”

LeBron James on D'Angelo Russell, Jarred Vanderbilt, Malik Beasley, Feb 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Will Hardy on Malik Beasley
item.description:
Eric Walden:Will Hardy, on Malik Beasley's injury:

“His ankle is day-to-day. I would hope that he's ready for the start of the regular season. But you know, with ankles, it's a day-to-day process how he responds to the treatment and the rehab workouts that he's doing.”

Will Hardy on Malik Beasley, Oct 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Chris Finch on Malik Beasley
item.description:
Dane Moore:Chris Finch on Malik Beasley's role this season:

“We’ve said that if you want to be a good team, you’re going to have seven or eight quality starter players. He’s a starter playerbut maybe best if the strength of his role with different lineups than the starting lineup.”

Chris Finch on Malik Beasley, Oct 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Jaylen Nowell on Malik Beasley
item.description:
Dane Moore:Jaylen Nowell on potentially starting while Malik Beasley is out:

“That would mean everything. Everything I worked for. That would be my first start, so obviously that's a big accomplishment. If that happens, it's cool. If it doesn't, that's cool, too.”

Jaylen Nowell on Malik Beasley, Feb 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on D'Angelo Russell, Malik Beasley
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on the D'Angelo Russell, Malik Beasley and Edwards three-man backcourt:

“They can't help off of DLo and Bease because they can shoot. And they can't help off of me because I can shoot -- *starts laughing* -- every now and again.”

Anthony Edwards on D'Angelo Russell, Malik Beasley, Feb 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Sachin Gupta on Malik Beasley, Juancho Hernangomez
item.description:
Sachin Gupta on the free agencies of Malik Beasley and Juancho Hernangomez:

“We do have plenty of room below the tax. We’ve got our own free agents with Malik and Juancho, so with the Bird rights we’ll be able to re-sign those guys.”

Sachin Gupta on Malik Beasley, Juancho Hernangomez, Oct 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Ryan Saunders on Malik Beasley
item.description:
Timberwolves coachRyan Saunders on Malik Beasley's arrest as @ Jon Krawczynski first reported:

“We're aware of the situation involving Malik and in the process of gathering more information.”

Ryan Saunders on Malik Beasley, Sep 27, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Michael Malone on Damian Lillard, Malik Beasley
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Malik Beasley:

“He showed me (in Game 1) that he can guard Damian Lillard.”

Michael Malone on Damian Lillard, Malik Beasley, May 1, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.
